items.description: CouponMoto provides coupon codes and exclusive offers to save you time and money while shopping online. The site covers a large number of stores. Coupons are updated and verified daily. The app is available on Google Play.
The Voucherify mashup allows to sell vouchers or coupons for through Shopify. Vouchers can be useful for exams, therapy sessions, and gift cards.
A picturesque look at the world’s best motorcycle roads.

This is a mashup in Ruby language created with World Weather Online and Twilio features. It allows users to interact with the APIs to receive weather forecast. For more information, contact third party developer JForaker on Github.
WebAloud uses the innovative twilio client to bring text-to-speech directly inside your browser. Just highlight the text and click play!
The Daily Top Five list in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year presents a new top five list compiled from sports, music, films, society, and more.
General travel and dining etiquette in the most visited countries.
Sophisticated Broadway show mashup lets you see where shows are playing and has times, pricing, tickets, directions, parking and hotel information.
Find the altitude of any place with a point-and-click interface.
Google map of the journey of John McCain from his birth place in Panama Canal Zone to possibly the White House.
Game that keeps track of Twitter users twooshes and ranks them accordingly. Tracks the length of your tweets, and the closer to a 140 character average, the better your score.
Fast Criminal Records provides the most complete online criminal records on anyone you know - instant, anonymous & accurate.
Wikinear.com shows Wikipedia pages near you, based on your location according to Yahoo! Fire Eagle. The site is optimized for use on a mobile phone.
Nearish.com puts you on a map with other Facebook users, allowing you to connect with people around you in realtime and visit others far away.

Daily Crypto lets you add crypto tokens to easily track their prices, price change & 24h highs and lows in your new browser tab! Tired of clicking through multiple sites, watchlists and more to track your crypto token prices? Daily Crypto replaces your default tab, and lets you easily access latest token prices of your curated selection of crypto tokens. From latest token prices, to price %age changes, 24 hour highs, lows and market cap ranks - we keep you updated.
Tthis is a resources for expats looking for work outside of America.

BetTips365 provides every day soccer (football) matches with the GH winning rate. We verify every single game each day to find the best solution for betting. BetTips365 show you the odds that bookies share with us, and that the game can be fixed.
Search for an artist and view videos, photos, and a discography for the artist.
Our encryption add-on for Box.net provides you with an additional layer of security and privacy by encrypting your sensitive files with unbreakable 256-bit AES encryption.
Search and follow tweets in near real-time using keywords/tags.
List and Map of activities and events near to Aviemore, Cairngorms National Park. Live product data pulled via the TourCMS Marketplace API and plotted on a Map via the Google Maps API.
Lord of the Rings Online game map using Google Maps technology.
Post and share events for free. Get local event information on your cell phone. Post and share invites. Uses the Eventful API.

Rentenna leveraged the BlockAvenue API to pull down local Block Reviews about nearby streets and neighborhoods and mashed it up on their property detail pages to help people who are looking to rent an apartment
Subscribe to a Flickr page, getting email notifications whenever you upload new photos.
The portfolio site of Ideum, an exhibit and Web design firm that specializes in multitouch and social media. Using WordPress and Flash.
Signin.in is a travel booking company that offers different types of booking services such as air ticket, bus tickets, train tickets, car rentals, holiday packages, and more.

YouTube Cloud is like a tag cloud. Instead of tags, this cloud is based on YouTube video popularity. The bigger the font, the more views that video has had. You can filter the cloud by category and time (today, this week, this month, all time). A video thumbnail preview is shown when hovering over a cloud link. Clicking on the links pops up a dialog to watch the video.
World box office movie search aggregates movie reviews, enabling users to find great movies to watch.
MyNextDive is new way to plan your next or fantasy scuba trip. Start learning about your next dive trip so that you are ready to go when you get there.
Keep up with the lastest UFO sightings with this combination of Google Maps and data from the National UFO Reporting Center.
Japanese Umeshu (plum wine) community web site.

Tracks the FriendFeed public feed to show statistics about FriendFeed. Shows data in a variety of formats in hours, days, months, or services, and allows you to drill down to a specific user or service.
This is a Mozilla Firefox extension for interacting with Amazon EC2. The utility lets you launch Amazon Machine Instances and then find, control, replicate and shutdown running instances.
A tool developed by the Nexmo community that will make it super easy to blast your SMS campaign from a simple Excel file.
Enter an artist name and get videos, discography, bio, torrents and related artists
Using an integration of the Google Maps API and TRAFFY developed by NECTEC, this app shows realtime traffic information in Bangkok.
A service that allows you to give floral gifts without having to know the recipient's address.

A freely browsable mapping database of over 130,000 US public and private elementary and secondary schools . You can map all the schools in a particular zip code of by freetext search in a particular state.
A very simple New York area craigslist apartment listings/google maps mashup.

Athenaeum is a mashup of Goodreads.com and Toronto Public Library created by Chris Nolan. Goodreads API allows to personalize book preferences, reason why the mashup can be found useful by members of the Toronto Public Library. Contents include how to use, tests, and known issues. Just like the author, users can automatically take checked out items and add them to Goodreads.com shelves.
